notes: High-level: mid-market analytics SaaS (product analytics/feature discovery). Evaluating embeddings + semantic search for product search + recommendations.
Buying path: start with Hosted API POC -> run embedding throughput tests -> if numbers meet SLA, move to Dedicated (reserved) pricing + trial cluster for production routing.
Quote from CTO (Rohan): 'Need predictable cost for nightly batch ingest of 20M events and <200ms vector lookup for UI queries. If hosted can't hit throughput, Dedicated is mandatory.'
Primary technical owners: Eng manager (Maya Ortiz), ML lead (Evan Ruiz). Security contact: Head of IT Ops (Noah Kim).

Current preference: embeddings model (open embedding) + small re-ranking LLM. Want to keep model choice flexible; prefer open weights (cost) but may accept Redwood-curated model if latency/cost tradeoff is better.
Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone (managed) and self-hosted Milvus 2.2. POC aims to test Redwood -> vector DB connector performance (bulk upsert, query latency under load).
Throughput targets: batch ingest: 20M vectors/night (batch jobs), steady-state online qps: 150-300 embedding lookup qps, p99 vector query <200ms.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budgeting, wants $/vector and $/query estimates; CFO flagged potential $120k/yr cap. AE asked for detailed cost model (hosted + dedicated delta).

POC plan: week 0-1: Hosted API quickstart + sample dataset (100k vectors) to validate correctness; week 2: stress test with synthetic workload (up to 10k qps throttled) to measure endpoint latency under batching; week 3: Dedicated sizing & pricing run, test connector for Milvus bulk upserts.

Security / compliance: requires SOC2, SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 13 months, optional KMS integration for keys in Dedicated/private deployments. Data residency preference: us-east for production.
Observed risks: vector DB bulk upsert time currently unknown (Milvus team needs to coordinate), concern about Hosted API throttles during nightly backfill windows.
AE notes (Aisha): Demo went well 2026-02-28 — product team liked prefix caching explanation. Ask: show batching knobs and cost delta in next demo (pricing line items + scaling examples).
SE note (Daniel): Will provide benchmark script for embedding throughput (python + k6 load harness). Will also test continuous batching vs single-call per doc in POC.
Procurement: procurement contact engaged early, legal asked for standard DPIA and data handling FAQ. CFO requested 12-month commitment discount scenarios for Dedicated.
Internal ask: prepare a sample Dedicated topology (2x A100-like equivalent) with projection of 95th p99 token latency for reranker calls and estimated monthly token/embedding spend.
'If we can get predictable latency and under $0.01/query for our 300 qps profile, we'll sign' — paraphrase from Head of Product (Jules).
